input_messages.content: Hi, I just placed an order with two watches, and I need to make some changes. Can you help me with that?
I don’t remember the email, but my name is Noah Ito and my zip code is 98187.
First, I want to change the shipping address. Please send it to my New York address—the one you have from my other order.
Just use the New York address from my other order. It’s already in your system. I don’t have the order ID handy, but it’s the only New York address on my account.

Yes, that’s correct. Go ahead and update it to that address. 

Next, I want to change one of the watches—the silicone one. I want it in metal instead. If there are color options, I prefer white.

Yes, do both of those changes. That’s fine.

Now, about another order—I got an air purifier with some sneakers. I want to exchange the purifier for a large size, with night mode, but still with a HEPA filter.
Yes, just the air purifier. Use my original payment method for any difference. Go ahead and start the exchange.
That’s all I needed. Thanks for your help.###STOP###
